# Midday sky

Kloofendal 48d Partly Cloudy (Pure Sky), Poly Haven, CC0.
Original HDR: Greg Zaal. Pure sky edits: Jarod Guest.
https://polyhaven.com/a/kloofendal_48d_partly_cloudy_puresky
https://polyhaven.com/license

Source: https://dl.polyhaven.org/file/ph-assets/HDRIs/hdr/1k/kloofendal_48d_partly_cloudy_puresky_1k.hdr
The 1024x512 HDR is used without recoloring. At runtime its brightest sky pixel determines the sun direction and colour (elevation about48degrees), shared by shadows, leaves and water. This replaces the previous low-sun sky for the current scene.
